item.title: Public Highway blocked by resident., 27th November
item.description:
Inhabitants of 6 ALSTONE LANE constantly put obstacles, cones bins etc, out on the public highway in front of their house in order to “reserve” the parking space. This road is a public highway and as such I believe they can not do this? Parking is already over subscribed in this area. I believe it’s an offence to block the public highway in this way? I have contacted the police and they said as the obstruction is “temporary”, ie removable, it is not a matter for them but it does fall under Highway’s responsibility. Can you help please? The neighbour at No 10 also does it. Please help.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Alstone Lane, Kingsditch, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
item.category: Unauthorised skip, scaffolding or building materials on the highway
